text:
anya: quick heads-up bringing up Meridian-9B (Llama FF + Gemma-attn graft). converter completed and int4 calibration done but long-doc summarization coherency degrades after ~900 tokens.
max: numbers?
anya: on doc-summarize-5k rouge-L -13 vs fp16 baseline; ppl jumps ~48 at ~1k. short context (<256) looks fine.
raj: classic triad: head order, rotary freq/phase, tokenizer normalizer. Any converter warnings in the log?
anya: snippet: 
```
WARN: detected_interleaved_head_stride=3
WARN: rotary_meta: missing per_layer_factors, defaulting base=10000
WARN: rotation_index_map: non-monotonic indices at layer 10
```
emma: interleaved stride 3 is unusual. If the converter flattened without permuting we'll get head-permutation, which shows up as low per-head cosine. rotation_index_map non-monotonic + missing per_layer_factors smells like per-head phase offsets were dropped.
max: can you run per-head cosine similarity fp16->int4 for q/k/v/out on a short seed?
anya: ran it. Layers 9-12 mean ~0.78 cosine, others >0.98. Also kv_cosine over timesteps: 
layer10: t0=0.997 t256=0.935 t512=0.708 t1024=0.384
layer14: t0=0.999 t256=0.998 t512=0.996 t1024=0.994
so layer10 decays rapidly.
raj: looks like rotary/phase mismatch in layer10. Any rotor metadata in the source model card?
anya: model card has notes: "rotary_groups": [10000, 5000], "phase_offsets": {"group1":0.0, "group2":0.25}, and a rotation_index_map array. But converter ignored unknown fields.
emma: that explains it. If group2 expects 0.25 phase offset and we used 0.0 everywhere, phase error will grow with position and show as kv_cosine decay. Also head stride 3 suggests the exporter interleaved heads across three groups; without permutation q/k/v are misaligned.
max: quick experiment results?
anya: 1) enforced contiguous head ordering in converter (permute weights) -> short-context metrics returned to baseline but long-context still bad 2) re-exported with per-layer rotary_group assignment (layer10->group2, phase_offset=0.25) + int4 per-channel calibrate on attn projections -> rouge-L improved +9 (now -4 vs fp16).
raj: good progress. Remaining delta could be quant granularity interacting with small-frequency rotaries or subtle tokenizer shifts. Meridian tokenizer preserves ZWJ sequences differently from our default tokenizer; long pasted docs had ZWJ sequences which cause token splits.
anya: I ran a token id diff on a long doc and found a split at pos ~872 that caused +1 shift for ~140 tokens until a punctuation boundary. Fixing tokenizer normalizer (preserve ZWJ where model expects) recovered ~1.6 rouge points.
emma: so compound issue: head interleave + dropped rotary group/phase info + tokenizer ZWJ handling + int4 quant noise.
max: proposed actions: a) update converter to read rotation_index_map, phase_offsets, and rotary_groups when present and emit explicit per-layer rotary metadata b) canonicalize head ordering when detected interleaved stride and include permutation map + checksum in model artifact c) add int4 per-channel symmetric calibration for q/k/v/out on affected layers, with option to fallback to int5/int6 per-layer for tail cases d) add preflight checks: kv_cosine curve up to t=1024 (fail if any layer <0.9 at t=256), kv_phase_skew threshold, and token_alignment regression on synthetic ZWJ-heavy long-docs e) for rollout, canary on Dedicated with 8% traffic and synthetic long-doc probes every minute; automatic rollback if rouge-L drop >3 pts for 15m.
raj: also add a runtime load-time validation: compute checksum of permutation mapping and compare with artifact; if mismatch, fail load and flag triage.
anya: I'll open a PR to patch the converter (rotary metadata + head perm export + tokenizer bundling). I'll also run a calibration sweep with per-channel quant on the affected layers and upload kv_cosine/kv_phase plots to the model registry.
ciabot: anya opened branch "meridian/rotary-phase-zwj-permfix" with 4 commits, CI queued.
ops-bot: scheduled canary deploy to eng-dedicated cluster at 2026-07-12T14:00:00Z routing 8% traffic to model:meridian-9b:v2-canary. rollback policy: rouge-L drop >3 pts sustained for 15m.
max: thanks happy to help with the calibration sweep tomorrow.
anya: appreciate it. will post canary results and plots once available.
